Liam H.: Question: shared room at conference last week. I booked a double at the Hyatt with Sam K but we each paid half on our personal cards. Can I expense my half?
Nina (People Ops): Yes, you can. Policy: we reimburse actual share of cost for shared rooms when traveling on the same business trip. Upload the full hotel folio plus proof of payment (your card statement line or scheduler confirmation). In Concur select 'Shared lodging' and add the roommate's name in the notes.
Liam H.: The folio shows the total and has both names on it. I attached a screenshot of my bank charge. Do I need manager signoff?
Liam's Manager: Confirming this was a joint trip and approving reimbursement for Liam's share.
ExpenseBot: Expense claim H-2001 submitted. Please ensure folio includes line items and taxes.
Connor (Finance): We'll process the reimbursement but please note we reimburse the lesser of (a) your documented share or (b) per-person nightly limit. If your share exceeds local per-night cap, you'll be reimbursed only up to cap.
Nina (People Ops): Quick tip: use the company card for shared rooms to simplify. If impossible, keep clear notes on split and save all receipts.
Liam H.: Got it, thanks everyone!
